provenance.gatheredBy: load-sport-data, the 2026 NBA Conference Finals as played: in the West the San Antonio Spurs beat the Oklahoma City Thunder in seven (18-30 May), in the East the New York Knicks swept the Cleveland Cavaliers (19-25 May). Both series are one event; game N holds both series' Game N, so Games 5 to 7 are the West's alone. The field is all four teams' rosters with their birth countries, from Basketball-Reference; ranking is the player's 2025-26 regular-season Triple Threat total (points + rebounds + assists) with these teams, both teams' for Jeremy Sochan (San Antonio and New York) and Riley Minix (San Antonio and Cleveland). Each game's box score (points, rebounds, assists) is from ESPN, cross-checked player by player against Basketball-Reference, which agree on every line; ESPN has no box score for the East's Game 3, so that game is from Basketball-Reference, cross-checked against CBS Sports, which agree on every line. Basketball-Reference also lists Oklahoma City's Isaiah Joe (Game 1) and Aaron Wiggins (Game 2) scoreless, where ESPN gives them no minutes, so neither has a line. A player who did not play a game, or scored no point, rebound or assist, has no line.
